description.p: A simple, modern GTK4 password generator that defaults to a privacy-friendly dark UI.
Pick balanced or custom character sets, adjust grouped length, and copy results in one click with an optional auto-close timer.
Keyboard shortcuts keep the flow fast: Ctrl+C to copy, Ctrl+Q to quit, Ctrl+W to close.
Ein einfaches, modernes GTK4-Tool zur Passworterstellung mit standardmäßig dunklem, augenschonendem Layout.
Wähle ausgewogene oder eigene Zeichensätze, passe gruppierte Länge an und kopiere mit einem Klick; auf Wunsch schließt sich das Fenster automatisch.
Tastenkürzel halten den Ablauf schnell: Strg+C zum Kopieren, Strg+Q zum Beenden, Strg+W zum Schließen.
Простий та сучасний генератор паролів на GTK4 із темним інтерфейсом, що дбає про приватність.
Обирайте збалансовані або власні набори символів, коригуйте довжину блоками і копіюйте результати в один клік з опціональним таймером автозакриття.
Клавіатурні скорочення прискорять роботу: Ctrl+C для копіювання, Ctrl+Q для виходу, Ctrl+W для закриття.

ul.li: Reworded the Ukrainian attack-rate note in the password strength tooltip, following review by the translation's contributor.
Added a Ukrainian translation, contributed by Dymkom, bringing the interface to eight languages.
Updated the Flatpak build to the GNOME 50 runtime.
The app no longer writes the first character and the length of a generated password to standard output, where it could persist in the system journal.
The password field now has a tooltip showing its exact entropy, a strength rating and an estimated offline attack time.
The estimate names the assumed attack rate, and the entropy accounts for the default strategy being weaker than its character sets suggest.
Fixed unreliable automatic clipboard copy on startup under Wayland.
The app no longer auto-closes before the password reached the clipboard.
Switched to OsRng for cryptographically secure random number generation.
Fixed inconsistent clipboard copy on startup by adding delay for Wayland focus handling.
Fixed "copy immediately" not working reliably at app startup on Wayland.
Simplified Flatpak build process (removed Docker dependency).
Internal project configuration improvements.
Updated project license to Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC-BY-SA-4.0).
Fixed AppStream metadata by keeping localized text inside a single description block so Flathub linting passes.
Switched to an SVG app icon and wired it into the Flatpak manifests.
Added light and dark screenshots across English, German, Japanese, Spanish, French, Italian, and Swedish.
Clipboard copy now defers until the window is active, improving first-copy reliability on Wayland.
Added keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl-Q to quit and Ctrl-W to close the window.
Introduced the "Default strategy" generator mode that enforces a balanced character mix.
Clipboard logging now outputs only the first character and length of each password for better privacy.
Ensured all translations stay in sync via automated coverage checks.
Switched project licensing to Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0 and included the license text in the repository.
Added developer attribution and homepage metadata to satisfy Flathub requirements.
Added localized UI strings for 7 languages.
New character-set toggles and copy success feedback.
Improved dark-mode integration that follows system settings.
Bug fixes and improvements
Added "Copy immediately" checkbox
Settings are now saved between sessions
